title: The Last Limit
description: Exploring the horizon in this Unstable-inspired SMP with improved worldgen and new features, you can form teams, gear up and survive the journey to the last limit of Minecraft!
body:
![The Last Limit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fdc548f6698f34d5d410008220efc28588b24b78.png) [![Alt Text](https://tr7zw.github.io/uikit/social_buttons_icon/Discord-Button-64.png)](https://discord.gg/8XuBmSEanY) [![Alt Text](https://tr7zw.github.io/uikit/social_buttons_icon/Modrinth-Button-64.png)](https://modrinth.com/server/the-last-limit)
The Last Limit is a Minecraft SMP where you can explore, fight, build, and create everything you want. ## Generic Features - Random starter kit for new players - Support for Bedrock edition, older versions, Simple Voice Chat, ans Distant Horizons - Kick on death - No offline mode, we don't like player data corruption ## Features you won't find anywhere else **Farlands!**
![Farlands map](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8557fa1a61a28a15d9eba407e5bb98d05bb98d7.png)
